<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,5,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Hawk!
We found a fish we've never seen,
so we came to report!

It looks like a lungfish...
but its fins are strangely developed.

Just like legs.
...You say it walked on land!

A lungfish that walks on land...
this might be one of the missing links.

One might call it the Land-Walking Fish...
Anyway, this is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>You did it, Hunter!
A huge discovery!
